limitations: All data is development data; no independent performance or final test.

The baseline is reconstructed using the reused frozen image/document vector set and 12 newly encoded label documents. It is not an exact replay of a different historical baseline run; Gemma historical 260 baseline has 42/147 hits here versus 45/151 in the earlier independent run.
The six long/block historical variants, image vectors, document vectors and saved scores are exact historical reuses.
The three extra Marco candidates still have no positive queries. Eight numbered descriptions remain unresolved.
Only 2 images and 12 documents were newly encoded per backend; encoding duration cannot support a speed comparison.
Four-play resampling intervals are exploratory; no performance-level or duplicate-group independent inference is possible.
Maximum-block aggregation is secondary and has block-count bias; no post-hoc default change.
